review: 702.74a-2: the only does_not_fire variant removed a land, which tests mana payability rather than the evoke alternative cost; added a no_evoke variant swapping Mulldrifter for Air Elemental (same three Islands).

scenarios.title: An evoked permanent is sacrificed when it enters
decisions: A casts Mulldrifter for its evoke cost {2}{U}, tapping three Islands.
Both players pass; Mulldrifter resolves and enters.
The draw trigger and the evoke sacrifice trigger go on the stack; A puts them in any order and both resolve.

variants.label: evoked
variants.expected: A draws two cards and Mulldrifter is sacrificed and goes to A's graveyard. Two Islands are untapped.

variants.label: hard_cast
variants.delta: A casts Mulldrifter for its mana cost {4}{U}, tapping all five Islands.
variants.expected: A draws two cards and Mulldrifter, a 2/2 flier, stays on the battlefield. No sacrifice trigger fires.

scenarios.title: The evoke cost is an alternative cost for casting the card
decisions: Evaluate whether A may cast Mulldrifter with three untapped Islands, the stack empty and main1 as the step.

variants.label: three_lands
variants.expected: Casting Mulldrifter is legal (can_play true) with the cost adjusted to the evoke cost {2}{U}; the mana cost {4}{U} cannot be paid.

variants.label: two_lands
variants.delta: A controls two Islands instead of three.
variants.expected: Casting Mulldrifter is not legal (can_play false); neither the evoke cost nor the mana cost can be paid.

variants.label: no_evoke
variants.delta: A's hand holds Air Elemental ({3}{U}{U}, no evoke) instead of Mulldrifter.
variants.expected: Casting Air Elemental is not legal (can_play false); with no evoke cost, only its mana cost {3}{U}{U} is available and three Islands cannot pay it.
